info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Status Inquiry API enables users to retrieve the current status of specific payment transactions. This endpoint provides real-time updates and details about payments, allowing merchants and financial institutions to monitor and manage their payment flows effectively. Common use cases include checking the status of recent transactions, tracking payment processing times, and ensuring operational transparency. Ideal for developers integrating payment solutions, this API supports efficient transaction management within various applications.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to check the current status of a payment. It returns detailed information about the payment's processing state, aiding in transaction tracking and management.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of payments. This body should contain the necessary parameters to specify which payment's status is being requested.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the payment status is returned.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected in the application/json format for the GET operation on the payments status endpoint.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_200.title: Payment Status Response

status.description: Indicates if the payment status was successfully retrieved.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the payment status operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment status request in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message related to the payment status.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for the payment status operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing information about the audit of the payment status retrieval.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
